title: Building a Miniature AI Factory: Post-Training, Inference Engines, and Provider Systems
description: A reproducible compact study of supervised fine-tuning, REINFORCE, PPO, RLOO, GRPO, workload-dependent inference-engine behavior, and an OpenAI-compatible provider boundary. The release documents a three-seed, 21-cell template-disjoint evaluation in which every tested adapter scored 4/128 held out.
